name: Mosca exitProgram pays fiat balances it never zeroes
summary: Mosca's exitProgram() pays out balance + balanceUSDT + balanceUSDC through withdrawAll but resets only balance, so a fiat balance bought once with buy() is paid again on every exit. With a USDC flash loan the attacker bought a 985 USDC fiat balance, then looped join (30 USDC) and exitProgram, collecting the 985 USDC each time in USDC and, once that ran out, USDT.
notes: Separate from Mosca2 (0xf13d281d on 0xd8791f0c): the redeployed contract dropped the withdrawAll payout from exitProgram, and Mosca2 abused join re-crediting balance, a different defect (rule 4).

Campaign: every exitProgram call on 0x1962b335 (campaign.mjs over the whole history) is the attacker EOA 0xb7d7240c's, except two by 0x09ea8b5e's contract 0x3be77a35 that paid in more than they withdrew.
Victim is the Mosca contract, netted per transaction against the attacker's joins and buys; join fees paid to the owner are not offsets.
